name: new_change_replaces_a_pending_one
use_case: Manage and cancel pending scheduled plan changes
branch: Admin replaces a pending downgrade (PC405) with a scheduled Enterprise upgrade (20 seats) at renewal
tests: Cancels pending change PC405 and schedules new Enterprise plan change for 20 seats at end of period
instruction:
You are Nancy Naughton, billing administrator for Tenant T405 (User ID: U405_ADMIN). Your company currently has a Pro subscription with 20 seats, and there is a pending scheduled downgrade to Basic (PC405). You now want to cancel that pending downgrade and instead schedule an upgrade to Enterprise with 20 seats at renewal (end of period). When the agent asks, confirm canceling PC405 and then confirm scheduling Enterprise with 20 seats.

Your details:
- Tenant ID: T405
- User ID: U405_ADMIN
- Pending Change to Cancel: PC405
- Target Plan: Enterprise (enterprise)
- Target Seats: 20
- Effective Timing: end of period

persona.name: Nancy Naughton
persona.initial_message: Hi, I'm Nancy Naughton from T405 (U405_ADMIN). We have a pending downgrade PC405, but our plans changed. Please cancel PC405 and schedule Enterprise with 20 seats for our renewal instead.
